blurb:
GEM Travel: 3-State Explorer (NYC → CT → RI → NYC)

Experience the Northeast the GEM way with a full-day guided journey across three states in one day, all from the comfort of a private vehicle. Begin with convenient pickup from your NYC hotel, then travel through Connecticut and Rhode Island, discovering hidden gems, scenic coastal views, and local foodie spots along the way.

This isn’t a typical tour, it’s a flexible, social experience where you can explore at your own pace, connect with fellow travelers, and uncover unique destinations curated for authentic vibes.

Sit back, relax, and let GEM handle the route while you enjoy the journey. End your day with a smooth return to your NYC hotel—memories made, new connections formed, and hidden gems unlocked.
